description: The plot illustrates Macro-F1 Score (%) as a function of the number of tokens for two tokenization-training conditions, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” with semi-transparent shaded bands around each line indicating variability. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0.5 to 1.5 with labeled ticks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4 (regular 0.2 intervals). The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%),” uses a linear scale, and ranges approximately from 48 to 58 with labeled ticks every 2 units (48, 50, 52, 54, 56, 58). The MATTER series is drawn as a solid pink line with circular markers; it is about 55.1 at x≈0.5, decreases to about 54.3 at x≈0.7, rises to about 57.0 at x≈0.8, reaches its highest point near 57.9 at x≈1.0, then declines through about 55.4 at x≈1.1 and about 53.0 at x≈1.2, shows about 53.5 at x≈1.4, and ends near 50.9 at x≈1.5. The “w/o material information” series is a solid purple line with circular markers; it starts near 52.5 at x≈0.5, increases to about 54.1 at x≈0.7, then trends downward to about 53.3 at x≈0.8 and about 52.9 at x≈1.0, continues around 52.4 at x≈1.2, dips to about 51.7 at x≈1.3, rises to about 53.3 at x≈1.4, and drops to about 47.9 at x≈1.5.
caption_used: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge during tokenization training across different numbers of tokens. The pink line representing MATTER (ours) starts at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score, peaks at 58% near x=1.0, and ends at 50% near x=1.3, showing a consistent decline after its peak. The purple line, representing w/o material information, begins at 52.5%, peaks at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range. The shaded areas indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2. The results suggest that MATTER consistently outperforms the alternative across all token counts, with a sharper decline in performance at higher token counts for both conditions.
